must be performed on an annually bases or every 8000 operating hours as indicated by

This document initiated by eng. El-Saeid Mohamed 
 Matarid, tested by eng. Ashraf Kamal El-Din Otba, reviewed by eng. Reda Ragab 
 Karam, approved by eng. Hamdy Ahmed Dorgham general director, accepted by eng. 
 Maamoun Abou El-Magd Atta Allah head sector of Damanhour Power Station.

This document certified by eng. Mona El-Sharkawy: 
 WEDC inspection & quality control head sector, MPIS coordinator.

A 
work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance staff should carry the suitable Id safety category.

Safety fence with 
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety helmet, shoes, 
ear plug and gloves pairs.

text:
Power 
 Station | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which 
must be performed on an annually bases or every 8000 operating hours as indicated by 
Y1 or H8000 in the title block.
Technical Specification
Rating 
 Power | 400 kw
Ampere | 47 A
Speed | 1490 rpm
This document initiated by eng. El-Saeid Mohamed 
 Matarid, tested by eng. Ashraf Kamal El-Din Otba, reviewed by eng. Reda Ragab 
 Karam, approved by eng. Hamdy Ahmed Dorgham general director, accepted by eng. 
 Maamoun Abou El-Magd Atta Allah head sector of Damanhour Power Station.
This document certified by eng. Mona El-Sharkawy: 
 WEDC inspection & quality control head sector, MPIS coordinator.
Safety 
Precautions
A 
work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance staff should carry the suitable Id safety category.
Safety fence with 
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety helmet, shoes, 
ear plug and gloves pairs.
A 
work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance staff should carry the suitable Id safety category.
Safety fence with 
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety helmet, shoes, 
ear plug and gloves pairs.
The motor must be out of service.
Circuit breaker in test position.
Tools 
and Equipment
Suitable tool 
set, Air Blower, Megger device
Greasing 
machine, Multimeter.
Fine cloth for 
cleaning purposes
Brushes, (soft 
brushes)
Suitable tool 
set, Air Blower, Megger device
Greasing 
machine, Multimeter.
Fine cloth for 
cleaning purposes
Brushes, (soft 
brushes)
Work to be carried out
Check the operation of the motor from local and remote 
operation on test position.
Check all protection devices of the 
motor by protection group.
Ensure that all fixing bolts are secured.
Ensure that electrical connection are tightened.
Check the 
 isolators and clean it.
Visually examine the winding.
Clean the winding.
Measure winding insulation 
 resistance.
Check the operation of the motor from local and remote 
operation on test position.
Check all protection devices of the 
motor by protection group.
